sequence_of_events: 2. proxy surfaced retryable failure as HTTP 502;
5. local project 48-call safety fuse later fired;
6. proxy encoded the LOCAL fuse as HTTP 429;
7. OpenAI client/tenacity interpreted project-local fuse as provider rate limiting;
8. multiple retries of the local fuse occurred;
10. subprocess chain terminated the entire DEV pipeline.

root_cause.details: The local project safety fuse of 48 calls was hit prematurely due to counting physical transport retries (503 backoff) and scoping across multiple native benchmark phases. When the 48-call fuse fired, the local proxy surfaced it as HTTP 429 Too Many Requests. AgentDojo tenacity retry decorator in openai_llm.py intercepted HTTP 429 as provider rate-limiting and repeatedly retried the local fuse, multiplying failures until openai.RateLimitError escaped, aborting the DEV run.
